title: fix(plugin-auth)!: a user a SCIM directory provisions reads idp_provisioned from its creation, and earlier ones are marked once at boot
body:
Fixes #32113

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — every refusal and hidden action keyed on a directory-owned identity (`sys_user.source = 'idp_provisioned'`) now applies to a SCIM-provisioned user who holds no local password: `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager` answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` with reason `idp_provisioned`; the admin bulk import (`POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users`) refuses that user's `manager_id` link through the same refusal; `admin/set-user-password` on a cloud-managed environment answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`; the Setup "Set Manager" row action is hidden; and the self-service Change Password, Change Email and Delete My Account actions are hidden (ADR-0135 D4, D5.2).
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no published skill states which identity source a SCIM-provisioned user reads; the one hand-written page that names the manager rule for directory-owned identities (`content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`) gains one sentence naming SCIM-provisioned users.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:SCIM 目录建出来的用户,从创建那一刻起就标记为目录托管(`idp_provisioned`);升级前已由目录建出的用户,在启动时按其 SCIM subject 记录一次性补标。
- 为什么改:ADR-0135 D4 要求目录托管的身份必须被标记,依赖这个标记的拒绝(设经理、批量导入经理、云托管环境设密码)和入口隐藏(设经理按钮、改密码、改邮箱、删除账号)才会对 SCIM 用户生效。
- 风险与回滚:对无本地密码的 SCIM 用户,设经理的三条路径都会拒,平台不从 SCIM 写经理,已有 `manager_id` 保持不变;审批节点可用 `onEmptyApprovers: 'fallback'` 兜底。停用/删除时先封禁再标记,标记失败不会让被停用的账号保持可用。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` 的 `reconcileScimUserLifecycle`(激活态先标记且失败即拒,停用态先封禁再尽力标记)、`scim-identity-source.ts`(规则与补标)、`auth-plugin.ts` 的 kernel:ready 补标钩子。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/scim-deactivation-reconcile-user.test.ts`,预期 23/23 通过,`(h)` 开头的是本次新增。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

ADR-0135 D4: a user a SCIM directory provisions is marked directory-managed (`sys_user.source = 'idp_provisioned'`) from the moment SCIM creates it, and users a directory provisioned earlier are marked once at boot.

- **The SCIM write path.** `@better-auth/scim` keeps its directory links in its own tables (`sys_scim_user`, `sys_scim_subject`). The seam every SCIM user write passes through is the vendor's `identity.reconcileUser` host callback (`AuthManager#reconcileScimUserLifecycle`): `POST /Users` calls it on a create, a tombstone re-link and the reprovision of an inactive source, and PUT, PATCH, DELETE and a projection-domain reconcile call it too. The mark is written through the data engine, which joins the vendor's SCIM transaction as its ambient transaction (`source` is not a vendor field, so the vendor adapter would drop it), with the same connection attribution as every other write of the request.
- **The order is the contract.** On an active state the mark is written first and fails closed: a mark that cannot be written fails the SCIM request, the vendor rolls the create back, and the identity provider retries. On an inactive state (a deactivation, a `DELETE`, a create with `active: false`) the deprovision write goes first and the mark after it is best-effort: a refused mark is logged once at `error` and re-run by the next active write and the boot pass, so it can never leave a deprovisioned account enabled. A failure that aborts the driver transaction itself fails the deprovision write too; that is the database, not the mark.
- **The boot backfill.** A `kernel:ready` pass in `auth-plugin.ts` marks every user that owns a `sys_scim_subject` row (the vendor creates one for every SCIM-provisioned user and never deletes it), keyset-paged through `keysetWalk`. It writes only a row whose value is wrong, so a second boot writes nothing, and it logs `marked N of M directory-provisioned user(s)` at `info`, where M counts only subjects whose user row exists. An absent `sys_scim_subject` table reads as zero users; any other read failure is reported at `error` with the consequence and the remedy.
- **One rule, both callers** (`scim-identity-source.ts#markDirectoryProvisionedUsers`): a user already reading `idp_provisioned`, or holding a local password (`sys_account.provider_id = 'credential'`), is left as it is. That is the federated branch of `stampIdentitySource`, unchanged, so a SCIM user who later sets a local password keeps the `env_native` its credential branch flips them to, through later SCIM syncs and boots.
- **The manager of a SCIM-provisioned user.** For a SCIM-provisioned user with no local password, the admin set-manager endpoint, the Setup "Set Manager" button and the bulk import's `manager_id` column all refuse ("directory wins, per identity", refusal 5 in `admin-set-user-manager.ts`). The platform does not write the manager from SCIM: it declares the SCIM `manager` attribute without projecting it onto `sys_user.manager_id`, and an existing `manager_id` value stays as it is. An approval node whose `manager` rung resolves to nobody for such a user can declare `onEmptyApprovers: 'fallback'` with a `fallbackApprovers` list; the other remedy is a provisioning path the deployment supplies that writes the column. `approvals.mdx` names the population in one sentence.
- The `sys_account` `afterInsert` stamp in `auth-plugin.ts` stays for adapter-level account creates; its comments and its two `error` lines no longer name SCIM as its path. `sys_user.source`'s comment and description in `sys-user.object.ts` name the SCIM writer beside federated SSO (the generated `en` bundle follows).
- The tenant-audit write-call-site census is re-measured on the merged tree (307 write call sites, 214 decidable, 123 with run-time elevation); the census page's prose figures follow.

## Tests

- `scim-deactivation-reconcile-user.test.ts`, top-level describes `(h)`, all through the real vendor SCIM routes on a real `ObjectQL` + better-sqlite3 engine:
  - `POST /Users marks the created user directory-managed, with no sys_account row to key on`
  - `POST /Users that re-links a deleted user through its tombstone marks that user directory-managed`
  - control: `a directory-provisioned user who gains a local password reads env_native, and a later directory sync leaves it so`
  - `set-user-manager refuses a SCIM-provisioned user as a directory-owned identity`: `403`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, reason `idp_provisioned`, `manager_id` not written
  - `admin/set-user-password refuses a SCIM-provisioned user on a cloud-managed environment`: `409`, `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, no `credential` account written, the user still `idp_provisioned`
  - fail-closed create: `a mark that cannot be written fails POST /Users, and neither the user nor its SCIM source persists` (SCIM error, status `500`; no `sys_user`, `sys_scim_user` or `sys_scim_subject` row)
  - deprovision order: `PATCH active:false with the mark refused still bans the account with the SCIM reason` (`200`, banned with the SCIM reason, one `error` notice)
  - backfill: `a pre-existing SCIM user is marked, a second pass writes nothing, a password holder and a non-SCIM user are untouched` (`{ 2, 1 }` with one write, then `{ 2, 0 }` with none), `the backfill pages by subject id and reaches every page`, and `a subject row whose user row is gone is not counted as directory-provisioned`.
- `scim-identity-source.test.ts`: an absent `sys_scim_subject` table is zero users and no write; any other read failure reaches the caller; a missing-table error naming another relation is not read as the subject table.
- `durability-swallow-repair.test.ts`: the healthy boot reports the backfill count at `info`; a backfill that cannot read is reported at `error` with the refusal in the Error slot.
- `scim-transaction-scope.test.ts` (unchanged) holds the mark write to the connection attribution.

## Acceptance notes

- ADR-0135 D4 says the row mark has "two writers" that "both fail open". This PR adds a third, on the SCIM reconcile callback, which fails closed on an active write and is best-effort after the deprovision write; plus the boot backfill. The ADR is a governed surface and is not edited here; the dated Note on D4 is filed as #32450.
- Accepted deviations from the contract review: the backfill has no completion marker and walks every subject row on each boot (idempotent; it writes nothing after the first pass); the narrow window in which a password holder can be marked is the same window the federated branch has.
